headline: Long-read and methylation-resolved methods link sequence context to epigenomic state
label: Epigenomic And Long Read Methods
summary: Long-read sequencing now resolves single-nucleotide methylation and somatic variation, with new pipelines making these analyses scalable and robust.
synthesis: The dominant thread is methods that resolve epigenomic and genomic state at high resolution and interpret it against sequence context. LEMONmethyl-seq provides targeted long-read profiling of single-nucleotide DNA methylation via locus-specific amplification and is applied to CRISPR epigenome editing and endogenous methylation patterns. A gene-centered framework prioritizes tumor-type-specific methylation biomarkers by integrating methylation contrast, intersample variability, context-specific reference layers and sequence features. Long-read pipelines extend this toolkit: Dogme reprocesses nanopore RNA and DNA modifications, Nallo covers CpG methylation alongside variant detection and assembly, and LRSomatic calls somatic variants from PacBio HiFi and ONT data. Other items address population-scale eQTL simulation, cross-ancestry eQTL portability confounded by power, CNV calling in targeted panels, and radiation-induced inversions and doublet substitutions. Taken together, the shared emphasis is on scalable, pipeline-based workflows that tie modification and variant calls to sequence and temporal context, though the items differ substantially in scope.
